meaning: Protocol_patient.jl aborts at load time if the prepared jugular recordings have no events.jl, and again if the selected patient (default "081" via _PATIENT) is not a key in JC_EVENTS. Every run of this protocol therefore requires the Python preprocessing step to have run first.

could_move.what: Any deck built through this protocol cannot be regenerated without the prepared data, e.g. the per-patient comparison deck.
The default patient "081" silently selects which recording is used when _PATIENT is unset, so results may be patient-081-specific.
The batch entry point inherits both errors; a missing or renamed patient key aborts the whole run rather than skipping that patient.

expectation: If the prepared data exists, no effect on numbers; if not, the protocol fails to load instead of running. Whether the default patient choice biases reported fits is unknown from this context.

check.why: Exercises the single-patient path this guard controls, showing whether prepared data is present and the patient key resolves, without a full multi-patient refit.
